limitations.reason: The complete campaign uses accelerated presentation on desktop at 1440x900. Normal-speed cinematics, mobile viewports and reduced-motion behaviour were not recorded.
The run used local Chromium automation; other browsers and device classes were not exercised.
The complete browser run exercised Wukong's successful deep route. Safe settlement, forced retreat, Bajie, and Sha Seng are covered by deterministic rule tests rather than separate browser runs.

The complete campaign run used mixed mouse and keyboard input; scenes were walked by clicking sprites and the quest tracker's auto-path. Arrow-key walking, minimap clicks and a keyboard-only campaign were not recorded.
The browser run covers one bounty ring. Shops, gear swaps, money skill study, rage stunts and the level cap are covered by node rule tests and a manual playtest only.
Grinding to the +1 level cap makes mob fights noticeably easier; only the final boss staying unwinnable on full auto is asserted.
